sheets.title: Little learner week
sheets.intro: Three little jobs each day, and a story together.

tasks.text: Write your name, then a and m
tasks.tip: Write their name big for them to trace. Say each letter as they write it.

tasks.text: Count 3 spoons with Papa
tasks.tip: Point to each spoon as you count. Then ask: how many? Say: three spoons!

tasks.text: Find 3 red things at home
tasks.tip: Find one red thing and say: red! Then ask: can you find 2 more?

tasks.text: Read 'I see' with Mumma or Papa. Find the cat.
tasks.tip: Point to each word as you read. On the first page ask: where is the cat?

tasks.text: Read 'a as in cat' and say each word
tasks.tip: Say the sound first, then the word: a, a, cat. Let them say it after you.

tasks.text: Show 2 fingers, now 3
tasks.tip: Hold up 2 fingers and wait for them to copy. Ask: can you show 3 now?

tasks.text: Freeze dance with Mumma
tasks.tip: Dance together, then say: freeze! Hold still, then say: dance again!

tasks.text: Read 'One, two, three'. Point and count!
tasks.tip: Touch each thing as you count: one sun, two eyes. Ask: how many socks?

tasks.text: Write your name, then m, s and t
tasks.tip: Say the sound as they write: mmm, sss, t. Praise the try, not the neatness.

tasks.text: Which plate has more grapes?
tasks.tip: Put 2 grapes on one plate and 5 on the other. Ask: which has more?

tasks.text: Draw what you will play, then play it
tasks.tip: Ask: what will you play? Let them draw it, then play it together.

tasks.text: Read 'I can' and do each one too!
tasks.tip: Read a page, then do it together: run, hop, sit. Say: you can do it too!

tasks.text: Open 'First sounds'. Which words start like apple?
tasks.tip: Say it slowly: a, a, apple. Then ask: does ant start the same way?

tasks.text: Count the plates at dinner
tasks.tip: Point to each plate as you count. Then ask: how many plates?

tasks.text: Open 'Animals' and make each animal's sound
tasks.tip: Make the sound first and let them copy. Then ask: what does a cow say?

tasks.text: Read 'Four, five, six'. Count with Papa!
tasks.tip: Count the legs, wings and points with your finger. Ask: how many now?

tasks.text: Write your name, then a, s and t
tasks.tip: Ask them to read their name back to you. Say: you wrote your name!

tasks.text: Find 5 in the number book. Show 5 fingers.
tasks.tip: Show one hand and count each finger with them. Say: five fingers!

tasks.text: Simon says: 5 turns
tasks.tip: Say: Simon says, clap! Sometimes leave out Simon says. Laugh if they move.

tasks.text: Read 'I see' again. You say the last word!
tasks.tip: Read each line and stop before the last word. Wait for them to say it.

everyDay.text: Tell Mumma or Papa your favourite part
everyDay.tip: Ask: what was your favourite part? Wait, then ask: why did you like it?

sheets.restMessage: No homework today! Play, draw, dance!

habits.text: I brushed my teeth after breakfast
I ate with my own hands
I put my toys away
I brushed my teeth before bed

sheets.title: Little learner week 2
sheets.intro: Three little jobs each day, and a story together.

tasks.text: Write your name, then b
tasks.tip: Write b big for them to trace. Say the sound as they write: b, b, b.

tasks.text: Count 4 cups with Mumma
tasks.tip: Point to each cup as you count. Then ask: how many? Say: four cups!

tasks.text: Find 3 round things at home
tasks.tip: Find a plate or a ball and say: round! Then ask: can you find 2 more?

tasks.text: Read 'The red hen'. Find the dog.
tasks.tip: Point to each word as you read. When the dog comes, ask: where is the dog?

tasks.text: Open 'Letter sounds'. Say b, k and f.
tasks.tip: Say the sound, then the word: b, b, ball. Let them say it after you.

tasks.text: Show 3 fingers, now 4
tasks.tip: Hold up 3 fingers and wait for them to copy. Ask: can you show 4 now?

tasks.text: Jump 3 times with Papa
tasks.tip: Count each jump out loud: one, two, three! Say: three jumps!

tasks.text: Read 'Snack time'. Count the food!
tasks.tip: Count on your fingers as you read. Ask: how many imli? Say: three imli!

tasks.text: Write your name, then b and k
tasks.tip: Say the sound as they write: b, k. Praise the try, not the neatness.

tasks.text: Which pile has more spoons?
tasks.tip: Make a pile of 2 spoons and a pile of 4. Ask: which has more?

tasks.text: Draw a fish and tell Papa about it
tasks.tip: Ask: what is your fish's name? Write the name they say beside the fish.

tasks.text: Read 'Good morning'. Do each one too!
tasks.tip: Read a page, then act it out together: brush, drink, put on your shoes.

tasks.text: Open 'Sound games'. Find ball, bus and bed.
tasks.tip: Say them slowly: b, b, ball. Ask: do they all start the same way?

tasks.text: Count 4 shoes by the door
tasks.tip: Point to each shoe as you count. Then ask: how many shoes?

tasks.text: Tell Mumma what you ate today
tasks.tip: Ask: what did you eat? Wait, then ask: which part did you like best?
tasks.cheer: You told Mumma about your food!

tasks.text: Read 'One, two, three'. You say the number!
tasks.tip: Stop before each number word. Wait for them to say it, then count together.

tasks.text: Write your name, then b, k and f
tasks.tip: Ask them to read their name back to you. Say: you wrote your name!

tasks.text: Open 'Count with me 1 to 5'. Say each number.
tasks.tip: Touch each picture as you count. Say the last number loud: five fish!

tasks.text: Clap 4 times, then stamp 4 times
tasks.tip: Clap and count out loud with them. Then ask: how many claps?

tasks.text: Read 'The pond'. Who can hop?
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: what can the duck do? Then ask who can hop.

everyDay.text: Tell Mumma or Papa your favourite part
everyDay.tip: Ask: what was your favourite part? Wait, then ask: why did you like it?

sheets.restMessage: No homework today! Play, draw, dance!

habits.text: I brushed my teeth after breakfast
I ate with my own hands
I put my toys away
I brushed my teeth before bed

sheets.title: Little learner week 3
sheets.intro: Three little jobs each day, and a story together.

tasks.text: Write your name, then d
tasks.tip: Write d big for them to trace. Say the sound as they write: d, d, d.

tasks.text: Count 5 spoons with Papa
tasks.tip: Point to each spoon as you count. Then ask: how many? Say: five spoons!

tasks.text: Find 3 blue things at home
tasks.tip: Find one blue thing and say: blue! Then ask: can you find 2 more?

tasks.text: Read 'The mango tree'. Find the bug.
tasks.tip: Point to each word as you read. When the bug comes, ask: where is the bug?

tasks.text: Open 'Letter sounds'. Say d, j and n.
tasks.tip: Say the sound, then the word: d, d, dog. Let them say it after you.

tasks.text: Show 4 fingers, now 5
tasks.tip: Hold up 4 fingers and wait for them to copy. Ask: can you show 5 now?

tasks.text: Hop 4 times with Mumma
tasks.tip: Count each hop out loud: one, two, three, four! Say: four hops!

tasks.text: Read 'Snack time' again. Who has two?
tasks.tip: Ask: who has two? Hold up 2 fingers and count them: one, two!

tasks.text: Write your name, then d and j
tasks.tip: Say the sound as they write: d, j. Praise the try, not the neatness.

tasks.text: Which plate has more rotis?
tasks.tip: Put 1 roti on one plate and 3 on the other. Ask: which has more?

tasks.text: Draw a cake with 3 candles
tasks.tip: Count the candles as they draw: one, two, three. Say: three candles!

tasks.text: Read 'My birthday'. Find the red hat.
tasks.tip: Point to each word as you read. Ask: where is the red hat?

tasks.text: Open 'Sound games'. Find duck, door and deer.
tasks.tip: Say them slowly: d, d, duck. Ask: do they all start the same way?

tasks.text: Put 2 pencils in a cup, then 1 more
tasks.tip: Count 2 together. Add 1 more and count again. Say: three pencils!

tasks.text: Open 'Body parts' and find your nose
tasks.tip: Ask: where is your nose? Then ask them to point to your nose too.

tasks.text: Read 'Four, five, six'. Find five fingers!
tasks.tip: On the hand page, count each finger. Then count on their own hand.

tasks.text: Write your name, then d, j and n
tasks.tip: Ask them to read their name back to you. Say: you wrote your name!

tasks.text: Open 'Count with me 1 to 5'. Count the ducks.
tasks.tip: Touch each duck as you count. Say the last number loud: four ducks!

tasks.text: Play copy me with Mumma
tasks.tip: Clap 2 times and ask them to copy. Then let them lead and you copy.

tasks.text: Read 'Good night'. Find the moon.
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: where is the moon? Ask: what do you do at night?

everyDay.text: Tell Mumma or Papa your favourite part
everyDay.tip: Ask: what was your favourite part? Wait, then ask: why did you like it?

sheets.restMessage: No homework today! Play, draw, dance!

habits.text: I brushed my teeth after breakfast
I ate with my own hands
I put my toys away
I brushed my teeth before bed

sheets.title: Little learner week 4
sheets.intro: Three little jobs each day, and a story together.

tasks.text: Write your name, then p
tasks.tip: Write p big for them to trace. Say the sound as they write: p, p, p.

tasks.text: Count 5 steps as you walk
tasks.tip: Walk slowly and count each step together. Ask: how many? Say: five steps!

tasks.text: Find 3 soft things at home
tasks.tip: Find one soft thing and say: soft! Then ask: can you find 2 more?

tasks.text: Read 'The little plant'. Find the bee.
tasks.tip: Point to each word as you read. When the bee comes, ask: where is the bee?

tasks.text: Open 'Letter sounds'. Say p, v and l.
tasks.tip: Say the sound, then the word: lll, lion. Let them say it after you.

tasks.text: Show 1 finger, now 1 more
tasks.tip: Hold up 1 finger, then add 1 more. Ask: how many now? Say: two!

tasks.text: Roar like a lion 3 times
tasks.tip: Roar together and count each one: one, two, three! Say: three big roars!

tasks.text: Read 'One, two, three'. Show it on your fingers!
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: can you show that many fingers?

tasks.text: Write your name, then p and v
tasks.tip: Say the sound as they write: p, vvv. Praise the try, not the neatness.

tasks.text: Which cup has more pencils?
tasks.tip: Put 2 pencils in one cup and 5 in the other. Ask: which has more?

tasks.text: Draw a pig, then draw 1 more
tasks.tip: Count the pigs with them. Ask: how many pigs now? Say: two pigs!

tasks.text: Read 'Bath time'. Point to the soap.
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: where is the soap? What do you wash first?

tasks.text: Open 'Sound games'. Find pen, pot and pin.
tasks.tip: Say them slowly: p, p, pen. Ask: do they all start the same way?

tasks.text: Put 3 spoons on a plate, then 1 more
tasks.tip: Count 3 together. Add 1 more and count again. Say: four spoons!

tasks.text: Open 'Transport' and find the bus
tasks.tip: Ask: where is the bus? Then ask: where would you go on a bus?

tasks.text: Read 'Snack time'. Who has three?
tasks.tip: Ask: who has three? Hold up 3 fingers and count together: one, two, three!

tasks.text: Write your name, then p, v and l
tasks.tip: Ask them to read their name back to you. Say: you wrote your name!

tasks.text: Open 'Count with me 1 to 5'. Count the balls.
tasks.tip: Touch each ball as you count. Say the last number loud: two balls!

tasks.text: Hide a spoon for Mumma to find
tasks.tip: Let them hide it, then you look. Ask: is it near? Let them give you clues.

tasks.text: Read 'I help'. Which one can you do?
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: can you do that too? Say thank you when they help.

everyDay.text: Tell Mumma or Papa your favourite part
everyDay.tip: Ask: what was your favourite part? Wait, then ask: why did you like it?

sheets.restMessage: No homework today! Play, draw, dance!

habits.text: I brushed my teeth after breakfast
I ate with my own hands
I put my toys away
I brushed my teeth before bed

sheets.title: Little learner week 5
sheets.intro: Three little jobs each day, and a story together.

tasks.text: Write your name, then z
tasks.tip: Write z big for them to trace. Say the sound as they write: zzz, z.

tasks.text: Count 5 leaves with Mumma
tasks.tip: Point to each leaf as you count. Then ask: how many? Say: five leaves!

tasks.text: Find 3 green things at home
tasks.tip: Find one green thing and say: green! Then ask: can you find 2 more?

tasks.text: Read 'Auto ride'. Say zip, zip, zip!
tasks.tip: Read together. On the zip page, stop and let them say: zip, zip, zip!

tasks.text: Open 'Letter sounds'. Say z, r and x.
tasks.tip: Say the sound, then the word: zzz, zip. Let them say it after you.

tasks.text: Show 4 fingers, now 1 more
tasks.tip: Hold up 4 fingers, then add 1 more. Ask: how many now? Say: five!

tasks.text: Stretch up tall 5 times
tasks.tip: Stretch together and count each one out loud. Say: five big stretches!

tasks.text: Read 'Four, five, six'. Count the star's points!
tasks.tip: On the star page, touch each point as you count. Say: five points!

tasks.text: Write your name, then z and r
tasks.tip: Say the sound as they write: zzz, rrr. Praise the try, not the neatness.

tasks.text: Which box has more toys?
tasks.tip: Put 3 big toys in one box and 5 in the other. Ask: which has more?

tasks.text: Draw your hand, then count the fingers
tasks.tip: Draw around their hand. Count each finger together. Say: five fingers!

tasks.text: Read 'How I feel'. Show a happy face.
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: can you show me that face? How do you feel today?

tasks.text: Which word starts like rabbit: rain or sun?
tasks.tip: Say it slowly: rrr, rabbit. Then ask: does rain start the same way?

tasks.text: Put 4 toys in a line, then 1 more
tasks.tip: Use big toys. Count 4, add 1 more and count again. Say: five toys!

tasks.text: Open 'Animals' and find the rabbit
tasks.tip: Ask: where is the rabbit? Then ask: can you hop like a rabbit?

tasks.text: Read 'One, two, three' again. Blow the candles!
tasks.tip: Count the candles together on the last page. Then both blow: whoosh!

tasks.text: Write your name, then z, r and x
tasks.tip: Ask them to read their name back to you. Say: x as in box. You wrote it!

tasks.text: Open 'Count with me 1 to 5'. Count them all.
tasks.tip: Touch each picture as you count. Say the last number loud each time.

tasks.text: Roll a ball to Papa 5 times
tasks.tip: Sit facing them. Count each roll out loud. Say: five rolls!

tasks.text: Read 'My family'. Who is in your family?
tasks.tip: Read a page, then ask: who is in your family? Let them name each one.

everyDay.text: Tell Mumma or Papa your favourite part
everyDay.tip: Ask: what was your favourite part? Wait, then ask: why did you like it?

sheets.restMessage: No homework today! Play, draw, dance!

habits.text: I brushed my teeth after breakfast
I ate with my own hands
I put my toys away
I brushed my teeth before bed

Read and write the days of the week
Learn vowel A

Write numbers 11 to 20 with spellings
Read vegetable names and write any 5 vegetables
Read and write the months of the year
Learn vowel E
Write numbers 21 to 30 with spellings
Write Hindi letters अ, आ, इ

tasks.text: Read flower names and write any 5 flowers
Read and write the names of shapes
Learn vowel I
Write numbers 31 to 40 with spellings
Read animal names and write any 5 animals
Read and write 5 body parts
Learn vowel O
Write numbers 41 to 50 with spellings
Read about good habits

Revise vowels A, E, I, O, U

I brushed my teeth this morning
I brushed my teeth at night

I ate my lunch with my own hands
